text:
marie.cs: Quick heads up — Auriga (pilot customer) is asking for a temporary QPS bump + IP allowlist for Sydney (ap-southeast-2). They have a live demo tomorrow and sales flagged a renewal risk if the demo fails. Can infra help with a short window?

sam.engineer: Yep. What's the requested window/scale? Are they hitting 5xxs or 403s today?

marie.cs: They see 403s from our edge (their webhook IPs are NATting). Request is to bump their route from 100 -> 800 QPS for ~3 hours and allowlist two CIDRs/ips so webhooks don't get blocked. No prod changes yet — staging repro is flaky.

ryan_infra: Ok. Need exact IPs, time window, and confirmation there's no regulatory blocking for that customer (they're not in gov). Also convo with legal/sales would be good for the renewal note.

marie.cs: IPs: 54.78.123.45, 54.78.123.46. Window they want: 2025-06-12 03:00-06:00 UTC (Sydney morning). They've passed compliance checks — CS confirmed.

lia_ops: @ryan_infra I can approve on ops side. Would prefer auto-revoke after 6 hours and a monitoring alert on error-rate and latency. Also set a soft quota so they don't spike beyond expected.

ryan_infra: Sounds good. I'll stage the change and request prod apply with auto-revoke. Can someone file a short note for billing / renewal so AMs know we supported the demo?

marie.cs: Filing renewal note now, pinging @accounting later about any overage.

deploy-bot: [policy-check] preflight passed for route auriga-prod. No conflicts found.

ryan_infra: Applying allowlist + temporary QPS bump. Commands I ran (for audit):

```
# patch route config
redwoodctl routes patch auriga-prod \ 
  --region ap-southeast-2 \ 
  --set qps=800 \ 
  --set qps_window=2025-06-12T03:00:00Z/2025-06-12T06:00:00Z \ 
  --allowlist 54.78.123.45,54.78.123.46 \ 
  --auto-revoke 6h
```

Applied to prod canary then rolled to 100%. Monitoring hook: auriga-prod.qps, auriga-prod.errors, auriga-prod.latency. Alerting policy attached to @oncall.

oncall: Confirmed alert subscriptions. Will escalate to SRE if error-rate > 2% sustained 5m.

sam.engineer: Verified via simulated traffic — no 403s seen after allowlist. Latency unchanged.

marie.cs: Amazing — thanks everyone. I'll message the customer and update the onboarding doc. Please confirm auto-revoke will actually remove allowlist after 6h (no manual rollback needed).

ryan_infra: Auto-revoke confirmed — token-based TTL. I'll post the audit id once available.

deploy-bot: Change logged -> audit_id: a1b2c3d4-auriga-1745600000

marie.cs: Adding renewal note: "Supported Auriga demo w/ temporary Sydney QPS bump + IP allowlist (2025-06-12 03:00-06:00 UTC). CS to follow up on any post-demo traction; sales notes potential renewal acceleration if demo succeeds."

lia_ops: I'll follow up to make sure soft quota is removed after the window and that the customer gets a courteous heads-up email 30m before revoke.

marie.cs: Thanks — closing loop. :thumbsup:

ryan_infra: Leaving here for records — reach out if anything flares.

marie.cs: (internal) note: track this in account_health/Auriga and add to renewal-risk board.
